These cubic samples were ﬁrst heated to 480 ◦C in an electric resistance furnace and kept for 60 min. In addition, the heating rate is 15 ◦C/min.

Then, the multidirectional impact forging (MDIF) was carried out using an industrial air pneumatic hammer machine (Shandong Chu Hang Heavy Industry Machinery Co., Ltd., Weifang, China) with a load gravity of 250 Kg. A pass strain ~0.05 was applied and the average strain rate was around 20 s −1.

One of the cubic samples was forged to 200 passes with an intermediate annealing treatment for ~10 min at 480 ◦C, and it was termed as MDIF100+100 sample (symbol + means an intermediate annealing treatment for ~10 min after the ﬁrst 100 forging passes).
